items.title: Navy Chooses Boeing to Build Next-Generation Jet Fighter
items.summary: The Navy chose  Boeing  to build its next-generation jet fighter, the latest in a run of contract wins at the aerospace giant’s military unit.  The deal, worth more than $20 billion, tasks Boeing with building the next-generation jets that will eventually replace the carrier-launched F/A-18 Super Hornet in the 2030s, the Navy said.  Boeing beat  Northrop Grumman  its only rival in the competition after  Lockheed Martin  dropped out of the running last year.
